mechanism: Ethambutol can cause optic neuritis and visual disturbances, which may be compounded by timolol's ocular effects and potential CNS penetration; additive risk of visual complications and systemic beta-blocker absorption from ocular formulation.
action: Monitor visual function closely during concurrent use; perform baseline and regular ophthalmologic assessments; counsel patient on symptoms of optic neuritis (vision changes, color blindness); consider alternative antituberculous agent if vision changes occur.
